summary: Round r1 (restricted network; search budget exhausted during 17A). Thirty-nine source leads located for India: the MoP cross-border electricity guidelines (2018) and CEA designated-authority procedure (2021), CERC CBTE Regulations 2019 with amendments, RBI exchange-control rules for Nepal and a reported December 2025 FEMA currency amendment, RBI monetary policy releases, NRB monetary policy 2025/26, Nepal-India trade and transit treaty texts, IGC releases, DGFT notification index, and IOC-NOC petroleum agreement release. Q1 (Indian policies most directly affecting Nepal): a dated watchlist of eight policy areas is defined; all status items pending primary retrieval. Q2 (cross-border electricity framework): six layers identified (guidelines, procedure, regulation, bilateral agreements, JSC mechanism, market access); consolidated text and approvals pending. Q3 (INR outlook): RBI publishes inflation/growth projections but not an exchange-rate forecast; INR/USD passes one-for-one into NPR/USD under the peg; all values pending. Three 2026 developments seen only in news (September 2026 agreement to review the trade/transit treaties; Indian import-side measures on Nepali goods; July 2026 JSC outcomes on power exports) require primary verification before scenario use. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1: Indian policies with the most direct effect on Nepal are organised into a watchlist (power-market rules, trade/transit treaties and their 2026 review, Indian import-side measures, export restrictions on essentials, petroleum supply, exchange-control rules, fuel pricing pass-through); see specific.policy_watchlist. Ranking of effect size is pending.
findings.note: Requires the primary notifications/texts in leads 17A-L01..L39 and Nepal customs HS-by-partner tables to size each effect.

findings.claim: Q2: India's cross-border electricity framework consists of MoP guidelines (December 2018, amended), the CEA designated-authority procedure (February 2021, amended) and CERC CBTE Regulations (2019, amended), plus bilateral agreements; the currently applicable consolidated provisions are not yet retrieved.
findings.note: Retrieve 17A-L01..L08; record effective dates of each amendment.

findings.note: CEA approvals list (17A-L04) and NEA annual report FY2024/25; approved capacity must not be treated as realised exports.

findings.note: NEA annual reports FY2022/23-FY2024/25 energy-balance and sales tables; IEX market data; primary owner 22B/17C.

findings.note: Agreement text and signed JSC/JWG minutes required; escalate to Agents 15 and 28 once verified because S05/S09 electricity assumptions depend on them.

findings.claim: Q3: Official Indian projections (RBI CPI and GDP for India FY2026-27) and INR/USD monthly series are unretrieved; RBI publishes no exchange-rate forecast.
findings.note: RBI MPC resolutions April and August 2026; RBI reference-rate series; IMF WEO exchange-rate assumptions.

findings.claim: NPR-INR peg parity and NRB regime statement for FY2025/26.
findings.note: NRB Monetary Policy 2025/26 (17A-L19); record parity only from the retrieved text.

findings.claim: September 2026 bilateral agreement to review the trade/transit treaties, and Indian import-side measures on Nepali exports, are reported by news only.
findings.note: IGSC minutes (MoICS Nepal / Department of Commerce India), DGTR/customs notifications; S02/S04 relevance; escalate to 15 and 28 when verified.

findings.claim: Supporting contributions assigned by 16A (X02, X03, X07, X08, X11, X13, X20, X21, X29): 17A supplies the Indian-policy and Indian-data component of each; all pending.

Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Under an unchanged NPR-INR peg, NPR/USD movements equal INR/USD movements; any peg change is a scenario assumption, not a forecast.

data_gaps: Text of the January 2024 Nepal-India long-term power trade agreement and of any earlier bilateral power trade agreement (not located).
Signed JSC/JWG minutes for power cooperation (July 2026) and IGSC minutes on trade/transit (September 2026).
Consolidated current text of MoP guidelines and CERC CBTE regulations after all amendments.
CEA list of approvals for Nepali generators with capacities and validity.
DGTR/customs notifications underlying 2026 Indian import-side measures on Nepali goods.
IOC-NOC petroleum supply agreement text (term, pricing formula).
Monthly INR/USD and Indian CPI for FY conversion; IMF WEO INR assumptions.
No official Nepali review document on the peg located.

assumptions.text: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
News and think-tank items are recorded as leads only to locate primary texts; they never establish status or values.
India FY (April-March) series are converted to Nepal FY using monthly/quarterly data; no relabelling.

challenges.text: X09 is framed as Indian export restrictions; 2026 news leads indicate Indian import-side measures (safeguard duties, import curbs) on Nepali goods, which act on X11/S04. Suggest adding an explicit 'Indian import-side measures' variable or widening X11's definition.
Source catalog lacks ids for CERC, Ministry of Power (India), DGFT/DGTR, PIB and IOC; primary leads 17A-L02, L06-L08, L18, L27, L30, L32, L34 have source_id null.
Please keep CEA-approved capacity, contracted capacity and realised export energy as three separate series; 17A will supply the approvals list and rule changes.
RBI does not publish an INR forecast; any INR/USD path used for the US$3T arithmetic must be labelled an assumption or taken from IMF WEO with its vintage.

uncertainty: High. No primary document was retrieved; statuses of the 2024 power agreement, 2026 JSC outcomes, 2026 treaty review and 2026 Indian import measures rest on news leads only. The consolidated Indian electricity rules may have amendments not captured by the leads. INR/USD outlook is inherently assumption-driven because no official forecast exists.

power_trade_rules.question: Q2 What is India's cross-border electricity trade regulatory framework?

framework_layers_to_document.instrument: MoP Guidelines for Import/Export (Cross Border) of Electricity, December 2018; addendum 2019; later amendments (2024 reported)
CEA Procedure of 26 February 2021 and amendments (Amendment-II reported)
CERC (Cross Border Trade of Electricity) Regulations 2019 and amendments
Nepal-India power trade agreement(s) incl. long-term agreement signed January 2024 (reported); earlier bilateral power trade agreement to be located
JSC/JWG on power sector cooperation (July 2026 meeting reported)
Indian power exchange segments open to Nepali sellers; prices
framework_layers_to_document.status: pending - IEX market data and NEA sales records required

power_trade_rules.method: Build a dated consolidated rule table (clause, amendment, effective date) from the primary texts; list each Nepali project's approval (CEA) and actual sales (NEA) separately so that approved capacity is never treated as realised exports.
known_issues: Approval (CEA) vs contracted (bilateral PPA) vs realised (NEA energy sold) are different quantities
Indian FY April-March vs Nepal FY mid-July
Exchange prices are time-block specific; seasonal averaging must be documented

inr_context.question: Q3 What is the INR outlook in official sources, given the peg?

peg_documentation.data_required: NRB statement of the exchange-rate regime and peg parity from the FY2025/26 (and FY2026/27) monetary policy; NRB reference rates

official_indian_projections.data_required: RBI MPC resolutions April 2026 and August 2026 (CPI inflation and real GDP projections for India FY2026-27, quarterly path); RBI does not publish an exchange-rate forecast, so INR/USD 'outlook' must be taken from IMF WEO assumptions or treated as an assumption

inr_usd_series.data_required: RBI reference rate INR/USD monthly, re-aggregated to Nepal FY

inr_context.method: Because NPR/USD = peg parity x INR/USD, Nepal's USD-denominated GDP (and the US$3T arithmetic) inherits INR/USD movements one-for-one while the peg holds; hand the INR/USD series and official Indian inflation projections to 20B (primary for X21).
inr_context.fy_note: RBI projections are for India FY (April-March); Nepal FY runs mid-July to mid-July; quarterly projections must be re-weighted, not relabelled.
inr_context.open_policy_question: Peg review debate exists in commentary (lead 17A-L21); no official review document located - pending.
